text: Subject: Music Service Offer from Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia To whom it may concern: Greetings! My name is [NAME] and I am the [OFFICER NAME] at the [CHAPTER NAME] Chapter of Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia music fraternity located on the campus of [SCHOOL NAME]. I am reaching out to you to see if we could set up a music performance at [LOCATION NAME]. We have a music service called the Mills Music Mission that is specifically for venues such as yours and we would like to share our love of music with you and your residents. The Mills Music Mission stems from a long tradition started by our founder, Ossian E. Mills. In the 1880s until his death in 1920, Mills would bring his fellow musicians and friends to hospitals and nursing homes each Easter and Christmas to sing and perform a variety of art forms. These outings were loved by all and especially important to the residents because they often could not attend religious services nor be with their families on those days. Mills and his friends would always have an abundance of flowers to give out to every person which consequently termed the event, “Flower Mission.” Mills devoted significant amounts of his time to uplifting the souls of the less fortunate with the beauty and power of music. He believed that people should use music to elevate others to the place where they may enjoy all that is true, beautiful, and abiding. He did this through music and the Fraternity’s Brothers continue this tradition today, more than 125 years after its inception. If you would like more information on the Mills Music Mission, CLICK HERE. We have a few dates that we are looking at this year and would like to know if you would be interested in having us be a part of your programs or activities. We also would love it if we could get information on your location to help us better prepare for our Mission. We would love you to fill out a Location Information Form (CLICK HERE), but I would also be more than happy to talk with you on the phone or in person. Please let me know at your earliest convenience. Thank you so much for your time and we hope to hear from you soon. Sincerely, [NAME]
